content:
Sam: Quick thread to finalize the webinar runbook and rehearsal cadence. Topic: 
- 40m content, 15m live Q&A.
- 3 micro-demos (each 90s live + 30s takeaway).
Priya: Nice. who owns the slide storyboards and the recorded fallback?
Sam: Ask speakers to submit a single zip with: 1) two-slide storyboard PDF (slide A = demo steps, slide B = takeaway + CTA), 2) prompts.txt (happy/edge/fallback), 3) expected_outputs.txt (one short exemplar per prompt), 4) recorded-demo.mp4 (90s), 5) tokens_estimate.txt (p50/p95), 6) bio+headshot. Deadline = Fri EOD.
Noah: Prompts format request?
Sam: plain lines like:
```
happy: "Summarize this changelog in 3 bullets for PMs"
edge: "Changelog >4k chars - extract top 3 impacts"
fallback: "If p95 latency >600ms, use compact-v2 and rerun"
success: "3 accurate bullets, no hallucinated features"
```
Emma: Rehearsals? timezone juggling is real.
SchedBot: Post 2 preferred 2-hour windows and I will create Zoom + calendar events tagged #webinar-rehearsal.
Sam: Plan: week-before speaker-only micro-runs (30m each), two dry full runs midweek, day-of morning tech check + final run. Proposed speaker-only blocks: Tue 14:00-16:00 & Wed 09:00-12:00. Full dress Fri 10:00.
Noah: Failover behavior: if a live demo stalls >10s/token or overall latency causes UI wait >5s, switch live to recorded-demo.mp4 and note fallback in tracker.
Priya: Who flips the fallback live? Ops or infra?
Sam: Infra monitors p95. If alert fires, infra pings Ops (@Noah) and SchedBot switches demo source. Speakers should include a one-line note in latency_notes.txt about expected p50/p95 in their dev tests.
Emma: Poll/gating idea for Q&A: start with a 1-min audience poll to surface top themes, then route questions: product -> first 10m, technical -> last 15m. Moderator = Priya, Q&A triage = Sam.
Noah: Metrics we track: registrant->attendee % (target 50%), live-demo-no-fallback % (target 95%), engaged MQL conversion (target 35-45%). Also log token usage and model variant per demo prompt.
Sam: Ops asks: include test-harness URL in your zip so we can run a smoke check during rehearsals. Also include expected_tokens.txt so we can estimate cost in real time.
Emma: I will drop my asset zip by Thu EOD and book 2-hour windows with SchedBot.
Priya: Will make a tiny tracker sheet: speaker, slot, assets_received (Y/N), live_latency_p95, fallback_used, recorded_demo_used, notes.
SchedBot: When you post windows I will create invites and attach the checklist in the event. I will also post ICS links back here.
Sam: Final ask to speakers: submit zip to this thread by Fri EOD, include latency notes, and tag @SchedBot with your preferred rehearsal windows. We'll confirm schedule Monday AM. Thanks! :sparkles:
